scientific_contract: Schema 1.0 remains accepted without rewriting user files.
pdf_md_complete requests the full artifact contract but cannot fabricate missing evidence.
External comparative sequences are opt-in.
Each record must retain accession/version/hash provenance.
Seeded sampling uses project.seed and remains provenance-visible.
External species never change target-material HOG occupancy denominators.
Logo represents aligned amino-acid conservation only.
Auto prefers audited HMM domain hits before precomputed alignment.
IDs must reconcile to accepted family members.
Whole-genome synteny is independent and default-off.
Backend and exact version enter provenance.
Only declared species pairs are analyzed.
Imported blocks require ID, coordinate and species-pair audit.
Fig17 uses only the declared representative intragenome pair.
Short or unordered blocks fail closed and cannot be rendered.
JCVI score threshold is recorded per pair.
JCVI tandem-distance parameter is provenance-visible.
Formal DE is independent and default-off.
Counts originate from featureCounts or an audited integer matrix.
TPM/FPKM are rejected for inferential DE.
Values must be non-negative integers.
Replicates, factors and batches must be explicit.
Every reported contrast is pre-registered.
Each compared condition must meet the biological-replicate gate.
DESeq2 uses BH-adjusted P values at the declared alpha.
DE status requires both BH-FDR and absolute log2FC thresholds.
Low-information genes remain explicit rather than becoming zero effects.
featureCounts annotation feature type enters provenance.
featureCounts grouping attribute must map to canonical transcripts.
R 4.6.1 and DESeq2 1.52.0 runtime must use @sha256 identity.
